event.title: ICE to Increase Deportations of Haitians as Protections Expire
event.canonical_title: ICE to Increase Deportations of Haitians as Protections Expire
event.summary: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is preparing to target over 300,000 Haitians who will lose their legal protections under the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) program. Plans reportedly include arresting migrants in various states, such as Ohio, and expediting their deportation to Haiti, which is currently facing significant crises.

timeline.title: Over 50 Military Spouses and Parents Detained Amid Immigration Crackdown
timeline.summary: An investigation has revealed that the Trump administration's immigration policies have led to the detention of over 50 spouses and parents of active-duty US military personnel. This crackdown is part of a broader effort to roll back immigration protections for military families as the administration pursues its mass deportation agenda.
key_facts: More than 50 military spouses and parents have been detained.

timeline.title: First Group of US Deportees Arrives in Liberia Under New Agreement
timeline.summary: Twenty deportees from the United States arrived in Liberia, marking the first group under a new agreement that could see up to 1,200 migrants sent to the West African nation. This arrangement is part of a broader immigration strategy initiated during the Trump administration.
key_facts: Twenty deportees arrived in Liberia on August 20, 2026.
The agreement allows for the deportation of up to 1,200 migrants to Liberia.
This is part of the Trump administration's immigration policies.
